description: Parkings vélo à Combs-la-Ville is a dataset listed in Combs-la-Ville open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Mairie de Combs-la-Ville. Retrouvez les stationnements vélo répartis sur la commune de Combs-la-Ville. Coverage: Combs-la-Ville. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Environnement. Its keywords are stationnement vélo, Combs-la-Ville. The portal shows 21 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-combs-la-ville-fr-portal.
